evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Text-to-SQL systems translate natural language questions into executable SQL queries, democratizing access to relational data.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: The emergence of large language models (LLMs), exemplified by systems such as ReFoRCE, Agentar-Scale-SQL, Snowflake's Arctic-Text2SQL-R1, and the modular XiYan-SQL framework, has dramatically advanced the field, pushing execution accuracy to new state-of-the-art levels on challenging benchmarks such as Spider, Spider 2.0, and BIRD.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: We further analyze evaluation metrics, datasets, and open challenges, including domain generalization, efficiency, and real-world deployment, and we examine the role of the semantic layer in production systems.
